Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/4] We had three measures that tapped areas of psychological distress. We used the Center for Epidemiologic Study Depression Inventory (Radloff, 1977; T1 diabetes a ¼ .90, T1 controls a ¼ .88; T2 diabetes a ¼ .93, controls a ¼ .92; T3 diabetes a ¼ .92, controls a ¼ .91); the UCLA Loneliness Scale, Version 3 (Russell, 1996; T1 diabetes a ¼ .82, controls a ¼ .86; T2 diabetes a ¼ .84, controls a ¼ .88; T3 diabetes a ¼ .86, controls a ¼ .87); and the abbreviated form (four-item) of the Perceived Stress Scale (Cohen, Kamarck, & Mermelstein, 1983; T1 diabetes a ¼ .67, controls a ¼ .73; T2 diabetes a ¼ .75, controls a ¼ .77; T3 diabetes a ¼ .79, controls a ¼ .72).
